# We create a group id that increments when the time difference between consecutive points is more than 1 (assuming data points are roughly 1 second apart or more)
anomalies_df_sorted['time_diff'] = anomalies_df_sorted.groupby(['cmdb_id', 'kpi_name'])['timestamp'].diff().fillna(0)
anomalies_df_sorted['group'] = (anomalies_df_sorted['time_diff'] > 1).cumsum()

# For each group (consecutive anomaly sub-series), calculate max threshold breach and extremal value
# Threshold breach = value - p95_threshold
anomalies_df_sorted['threshold_breach'] = anomalies_df_sorted['value'] - anomalies_df_sorted['p95_threshold']
